architecture.mechanism: Hybrid multi-material systems for mechanical protection and integration
architecture.intervention: Replace the standard harness cable retention clips behind the rearview mirror with a hybrid multi-material system combining a glass-fiber-reinforced thermoplastic structural bracket and a thermoset composite strain-relief boot to resist deformation from foreign object placement while maintaining electrical connectivity.
architecture.expected_effect: The hybrid assembly will prevent cable detachment under repeated foreign object intrusion by providing superior crashworthiness and mechanical protection compared to single-material components, ensuring the shifter interlock remains functional.
architecture.falsification_test: Subject the modified harness assembly to 10,000 cycles of controlled foreign object insertion (simulating a coat hanger or tool) behind the rearview mirror while monitoring continuity; failure is defined as any loss of electrical signal or visible cable detachment.
